learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has not fired since 2026-06-30 — the 07-01/07-02 sessions did not run and today's 07-06 midday is operating on a ~6-day-old matrix. SAFE MODE has now persisted across a multi-day gap, meaning NO signal-based action has been possible for nearly a week. The §2.5 freshness guard is doing its job (blocking stale-data entries), but the underlying scheduler/runner failure is the single highest-priority operational fix.

Broker state is the source of truth (§5.1). Across a 6-day session gap the held book is unchanged (7 positions, same shares) and reconciles cleanly to memory — confirming that when no session runs, positions simply persist and the next session must re-anchor on the broker, not on the age of the prose.

The between-session fractional monitor (fractional_positions.json) is the only stop coverage when sessions miss. Over the 6-day gap all three LAB stops held with wide margin (INTC +9.9%, ARKK +13.7%, NVDA +3.1% above stop), so no breach occurred — but the episode underlines that a stale fractional_positions.json would have been the sole safety net. Keeping it current every session is non-negotiable.

The 06-30 composites stayed NEUTRAL/BEARISH even as price ripped; six sessions later semis have given back much of that spike (SOXX -4.6% from entry, INTC -3.9%). The lagging-composite pattern cuts both ways — a neutral blend during a sharp move is a signal that the move is unconfirmed, not that it will persist.

One $36 cash->JEPQ reallocation (06-30) still holds the book near the staging glide path (LAB 25.8 / CORE 50.1 / DRIP 23.9 vs 20/50/30). LAB remains over its 20% cap and dilutes only via base growth (§17.3); with ~$0 cash and no deposits, allocation is static until new capital arrives.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null persist, so the §15.3 screen stays unverifiable. Covered-call names can seed on yield; dividend-growth names wait on the streak/payout fix.
